scope: 48 reference cells split into eight reviewable design files.

artDirection.corePalette: black ink, dark navy, violet-black, blue-gray, old-paper accents
artDirection.readability: Read silhouette and role at 1x before detail.
artDirection.enemyFamilyRule: Shared black-ink world, but never black blobs only.
artDirection.warmLightRule: Warm light is a small focal accent and must not compete with player lantern, pickups or hit core.
artDirection.outlineRule: Selective dark outline; avoid uniform thick black contour.
artDirection.productionRule: Reference generation is not final art. Aseprite hand-finish is mandatory.
